description: Merges release-notes into db-migrate and drops the ticket-id exception.

.claude/skills/db-migrate/scripts/collec.content:
#!/bin/sh
# List merged changes since the last tag, one per line.
last=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)
git log --merges --format='%s' "$last"..HEAD
echo "Collected $(git log --merges --format='%s' "$last"..HEAD | wc -l | tr -d ' ') changes"

---
name: db-migrate
description: Plan and check database schema migrations. Use when the user asks to add, review or run a migration.
---
# Database migrations

1. Run `scripts/check_migrations.sh` to list pending migrations in `db/migrations/`.
2. Explain each pending migration before running anything.
3. For release notes, run [the collector](scripts/collect.sh) and print its summary line.

Do not run migrations against production unless the user names the change ticket.
